items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Broadway Jones' is mentioned by the interviewer in a question ('He's not talking about Broadway Jones, is he?'), but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond to this specific mention or provide any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship.

ctx.x: No, I just had a stop by one night. Emperor Jones? That sounds like Charles Gilbert or Paul Robeson
He's not talking about Broadway Jones, is he?

I don't know. Anyhow, just stopped by one night and there's a tremendous musician by the name of Sam Wooding, he has the band there. And another helluva guy by the name of Charlie Dixon doing the arrangements, you know.
